newsitem.title: UK: HSBC Midland hires international economist Tyson.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Midland hires international economist Tyson.

text.p: HSBC Midland, part of the HSBC Holdings group, has appointed Philip Tyson as senior international economist.
Tyson joins HSBC from CS First Boston where he was vice president, fixed income research. He has previously worked at UBS and Yamaichi.
HSBC said the appointment marked the continuing expansion of the international economics team reporting to chief international economist Mark Cliffe.
Recent additions to the team include Don Smith, from UK economics, and Ros Lifton, who joined from Daiwa Europe. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
